source.name: CMU ARCTIC Speech Databases
source.license: CMU free-software license; official report states no restriction on commercial or non-commercial use
source.recording: approximately 1,150 phonetically balanced read-English utterances per speaker, 16 kHz studio audio
source.alignment: phonetic labels produced with CMU Sphinx/FestVox labeling scripts

selection_rule: Partition all 18 published speakers before access, balancing reported sex 2F/3M in development and 3F/2M in confirmation while placing standard and accented English voices in both groups.
mapping_rationale: These ARPAbet monophthong labels most closely match Cora's existing fixed F1/F2 targets; mapping is frozen before label or audio access and labels may only select/score windows.
development_policy: Only development archives may be fetched while token-duration rules, windowing, LPC/formant representation, and confirmation thresholds are developed.
confirmation_policy: No confirmation archive, label, waveform, header, or member listing may be fetched or inspected until implementation and all confirmation gates are committed. A failed confirmation spends all five speakers.
repository_policy: Archives and extracted audio remain outside Git. The repository retains source metadata, selected filenames/segments, hashes, protocols, code, and aggregate results only.
claim_boundary: This split does not improve H4. CMU Arctic is read ordinary speech with automated alignments, not spontaneous conversation, isolated sustained vowels, infant speech, or motor learning evidence.
